rv.q: For those who like full-throated, unapologetically dramatic singing, this is a dream cast for you.
Sometimes it takes a new voice to make you hear old music as if for the first time.
In all, this was Hernández's evening and one hopes that she will return soon to headline a new production.

cn.t: Saioa Hernández's Met debut in Tosca earns strong praise for her full-throated, dramatically uncompromising singing, leading a powerhouse cast that delivers unapologetically bold performances.
